title: Testing another DD install replaces the machine's resident
trigger: Before running hooks, the MCP server, check-codex or the OpenCode adapter from any DD copy other than this checkout (plugin cache, npm install, test copy)
behavior_delta: Set DD_RESIDENT_REGISTRY to a temporary file (or DD_RESIDENT=0), or HOME/USERPROFILE to a scratch dir, and stop the resident it started afterwards.
what: Set DD_RESIDENT_REGISTRY to a temporary file (or DD_RESIDENT=0), or HOME/USERPROFILE to a scratch dir, and stop the resident it started afterwards.
why: There is one resident per machine and a resident from another build is retired and replaced at session start, so a test copy kills the user's working resident and invalidates the audit UI address they were given (seen 2026-09-23 when a Grok test copy's installer replaced it).

evidence_refs.summary: ensureResident starts a replacement for any resident whose build differs; registryPath honors DD_RESIDENT_REGISTRY
Item 4 records the replacement conflict between installs
